summary: Iter37: tested the quotes features inside the agenda. Backend: 9 pytest checks on /api/quotes CRUD, numbering, upper-casing, idempotency, soft-delete clearing the client's quote_ref, user isolation, import (idempotent, counter, relinking jobs, company) and quote-settings; 8/9 pass. Frontend: full flow on WebKit with iPhone 13 emulation (390px): Fai preventivo, editor, preview, PDF, filters and search, Crea lavoro from a row, job-quote-create and job-quote-open, delete. Found and fixed 2 real bugs: (1) the blue theme (and every other theme's colour overrides) never applied because of double-escaped CSS selectors; (2) the editor's fixed Salva/Invia PDF bar was pushed off-screen by the fade-in transform. Retested after both fixes.

minor.issue: Updates a soft-deleted quote and returns 200. The filter is missing is_deleted != True.

Uses the full QuoteIn model, so a partial PUT (e.g. {status:'sent'}) resets lineItems, paymentTerms and clientName to defaults. It also does not upper-case clientName or clientAddress (only the frontend does).
Duplicate numbers are allowed when a number is given explicitly. The default date uses server local time (datetime.now()), not the user's timezone.
Imported clientName and clientAddress are not upper-cased.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Selectors like [class*="bg-\\[\\#4A5D23\\]"] contained literal backslashes, so they never matched. With the default theme set to blu-italserrande, buttons, nav and background stayed green/beige on Prossimi, Agenda and the editor. Fix: unescaped the brackets, # and : inside the quoted attribute selectors. Verified: Esegui oggi, Timbra ingresso, Giorno and the active bottom-nav item are now blue.

FIXED by testing agent. The root div had the fade-in class, whose animation keeps transform: translateY(0) after it ends (fill-mode both). That makes the position:fixed bar behave like absolute: barTop was 1248px in a 664px viewport, so Salva and Invia PDF were invisible without scrolling to the bottom. Removed fade-in from the editor root; the bar now sits just above the bottom nav (top 479, bottom 592).

issues: Terracotta #B8683D has no blu-italserrande override, so Nuovo lavoro, Invia PDF, the badge counters and the date text stay orange/brown.
[class*="bg-[#3C4C1C]"] also matches 'hover:bg-[#3C4C1C]', so buttons with that hover class always show the darker #003a8c instead of #0047ab.
The action bar wraps into 2 rows (113px tall): Invia PDF on one row, Salva on the next.
Bottom nav 'Preventivi' is not highlighted on /preventivi/:id.
ScaledPreview's negative marginBottom uses a % of width (calc(-(1-scale)*100%)), not of page height, so the space under the A4 preview is wrong.

The layout matches the sample very closely (header, logo, Cliente / Preventivo: / Data box, Descrizione / Importo € / C. Iva table, OGGETTO, Tot. Imponibile (IVA ESCLUSA), Modalità di pagamento). Only the page margins are slightly larger and the content slightly smaller than in the sample.

action_items: Review the CSS selector fix in index.css (backslashes removed) and add blu-italserrande overrides for #B8683D, plus a proper base vs hover distinction.
PUT /api/quotes: add is_deleted != True to the filter, upper-case clientName and clientAddress on the server, and consider exclude_unset for partial updates.
Upper-case clientName and clientAddress on import too.
Check other pages where fixed elements sit inside a .fade-in container (same transform containing-block problem).
UI import button 'Importa dalla vecchia app Preventivi' NOT tested (needs the user's real old-app credentials).
critical_code_review_comments: quotes.py update_quote uses model_dump() of the full model, so defaults overwrite stored fields on partial payloads.
QuoteEditor remove(): api.delete has no try/catch, so an error gives no toast.
jobPrefill date uses new Date().toISOString() (UTC). Around midnight in Italy it can be the wrong day.
The 'In HTML <span> cannot be a child of <option>' console error comes from the visual-editor instrumentation (x-excluded span), not from app code.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows pass after 2 fixes (blue theme and the editor action bar were broken before the fixes)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Firebase users only. Their quotes, clients and Firebase accounts were deleted afterwards; empty quote_settings docs for those ephemeral uids may remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run WebKit flows with `python /app/tests/iter37_ui.py` (it uses ios_check.main; Chromium is not installed). Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_quotes.py -p no:xdist. The sandbox clock is 2026-11-23. The preview's 'Preventivo:' label matches sample.pdf (it is not 'Preventivo N°').
rca of the issue: Theme: in a quoted CSS attribute value, '\\[' means a literal backslash followed by '[', so the substring never appears in a class attribute. Checked in isolation with WebKit set_content (/app/tests/iter37_css.py): the double-escaped rule did not apply, the plain rule did. Action bar: .fade-in uses 'animation ... both', which keeps a transform after the animation. A transformed ancestor becomes the containing block for position:fixed children, so the bar sat at the bottom of the 1409px page instead of the viewport.
